name: Monik Saab
quote: Underwater, everybody helps everybody. I wish it were like that on land.
about: "I grew up by the beach in Brazil. After 16 years in large corporations and teaching English, I made the sea my work. Today I'm a PADI dive instructor and a licensed expedition guide in Mexico. I've lived in Baja California Sur for six years, one of them in La Paz."
history: "I've guided groups of every size, from all over the world. On a sailboat, I prefer small ones. From the first briefing, I watch how each diver moves, who is relaxed and who is nervous, and I plan the dives around them."
why: "What keeps me at sea is the life underwater. Ocean people are like a family: everybody helps everybody. I left corporate life to have fun and to make people as happy as the sea makes me."
imageAlt: Monik, expedition leader with Eagle Ray Expeditions
